sources.title: Existing Boracay weather page – legacy beach marker dataset
sources.limitations: Coordinates and broad coast classifications were carried over from the existing weather page. These are legacy map markers, not independently surveyed beach centroids or verified boundary points.

sources.title: Boracay Map – Tourism Promotions Board Philippines
sources.limitations: Map labels and grid references establish named places, not surveyed beach boundaries or precise beach-centroid coordinates.

sources.title: Recreational Waters Monitoring Program: Annual Water Quality Assessment Report, Boracay Island, January–December 2022
sources.publisher: DENR Environmental Management Bureau Region VI
sources.limitations: Historical monitoring data from 2022. Sampling stations are not necessarily co-located with the whole beach; results must not be presented as current water quality.

sources.title: Environmental Performance Report and Management Plan – Boracay Island Water Supply System Project
sources.publisher: DENR Environmental Management Bureau Region VI
sources.limitations: Report describes monitoring station locations and historical water quality; not a real-time beach safety bulletin.

sources.title: Boracay Island Hopping Tour – seasonal meeting point information
sources.limitations: Operator-specific listing. Meeting point is not proof of an officially designated island-wide departure terminal. Stops are itinerary-dependent and can change.

sources.title: Boracay Private Island Hopping with Lunch
sources.limitations: Confirms operator's seasonal meeting locations only; exact boat boarding arrangements remain subject to operator instructions and sea conditions.

sources.title: Boracay Island Hopping with Buffet Lunch & ATV Adventure
sources.limitations: Secondary operator/booking information. Must be rechecked before any time-sensitive public statement.

sources.publisher: Philippine Department of Tourism / DENR-EMB project report map
